summary.headline: Autopilot comparison and Intune endpoint references receive routine maintenance
summary.overview: The day’s ten changes update Autopilot device-preparation comparison, Intune endpoints, Android OEMConfig, and release documentation, while a Configuration Manager hotfix page is removed.
summary.adminImpact: No tenant change is indicated. Refresh Autopilot device-preparation comparison and endpoint references in deployment documentation, and consult the current Configuration Manager hotfix catalog if you had bookmarked the removed page.

keyChanges.title: Device-preparation comparison guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Autopilot comparison article receives maintenance updates and remains the current reference for comparing device-preparation approaches.

keyChanges.title: Intune endpoint documentation is refreshed
keyChanges.detail: The endpoint reference is updated, maintaining current network and service guidance for Intune deployments.

summary.headline: Security baseline and unenrolled-device Defender guidance are updated
summary.overview: The day refreshes security baseline settings, Defender for Endpoint management from Intune for unenrolled devices, Remote Help monitoring, Intune add-ons, and Configuration Manager hotfix information.
summary.adminImpact: Review baseline changes before using the reference to update policy baselines, and validate the guidance for managing Defender on unenrolled devices against your chosen security-management model. Evaluate the reissued Configuration Manager client fix by affected version and symptom.

keyChanges.title: Security baseline settings guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The MDM security baseline settings reference receives a substantial update, keeping current policy and baseline information available to administrators.

keyChanges.title: Unenrolled-device Defender management guidance is refreshed
keyChanges.detail: The documentation for using Intune endpoint-security policies with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint devices that are not enrolled in Intune is updated.

summary.headline: Security baseline follow-up and Configuration Manager hotfixes are published
summary.overview: Security baseline documentation receives follow-up changes while Configuration Manager publishes client-fix and offline-feedback hotfix references for supported versions.
summary.adminImpact: Configuration Manager teams should assess the listed hotfixes against their version and symptoms before deployment. Treat baseline documentation changes as a prompt to review policy intent and current configuration rather than an automatic baseline redeployment.

keyChanges.title: Security baseline references are refined
keyChanges.detail: The security baseline overview and MDM settings pages receive updates, providing current baseline configuration and support guidance.

keyChanges.title: Configuration Manager offline feedback failure hotfix is published
keyChanges.detail: A new hotfix article addresses offline feedback submission failure using UploadOfflineFeedback.exe, providing a version-specific remediation reference.

summary.headline: Configuration Manager offline feedback update is refined
summary.overview: All five changes refine the Configuration Manager offline-feedback hotfix documentation for releases 2403, 2409, and 2503.
summary.adminImpact: If offline feedback submission is part of your support workflow, use the current hotfix guidance and validate applicability against the installed Configuration Manager release before deployment.

keyChanges.title: Offline feedback update is documented for supported Configuration Manager releases
keyChanges.detail: The updated hotfix guidance covers the UploadOfflineFeedback.exe submission failure and associated remediation across Configuration Manager 2403, 2409, and 2503.

summary.headline: March opens with Zero Trust, baseline, and Configuration Manager remediation guidance

summary.adminImpact: Use the refreshed Zero Trust and baseline material for policy-review work, evaluate management of Defender on unenrolled devices deliberately, and triage Configuration Manager fixes by exact version and observed symptom.

keyChanges.title: Zero Trust security documentation is refreshed
keyChanges.detail: The Intune Zero Trust configuration guide receives a major revision and remains the strategic reference for security configuration planning.

keyChanges.title: Security baselines receive follow-up updates
